scope: Anti-overfitting audit covering the six studies run by research worker 1: g_trend, g_multi_timeframe, g_momentum, g_vwap, g_liquidity, g_opening_range. Measured on MES, NQ, MNQ, MGC and MCL at 15m, 30m, 60m, 240m and daily, 8,703 rule sets with at least one trade and 1,818 clearing a 20-trade floor, plus 16 purpose-built paired cells.
bottom_line: Nothing here is live-eligible. Two independent bars are failed: the best t-statistic in the whole population is 3.923 against free_t = 4.148 at this search size, and in-sample expectancy has essentially no rank correlation with out-of-sample expectancy on the equity indices.

look_ahead_bias.how_checked: Read the engine's stated invariants and confirmed them in code: signals come from SymbolFrame.snapshot(i) which contains no data after bar i; FillModel.entry_on_next_open defaults True; when a bar contains both stop and target the stop is assumed to fill first; gaps fill at the open, adversely. Also confirmed opening_range_breakout refuses to fire on an incomplete range.
look_ahead_bias.found: No look-ahead found in the fill path. The structural guards are real, not comments.

repainting_indicators.how_checked: Evaluated the multi-timeframe and liquidity conditions bar by bar on full series and compared verdicts across frame stacks. A repainting condition would give different answers for the same bar depending on later data; the frame-depth negative control shows the opposite - strategies that do not consult higher timeframes produce byte-identical results when a higher timeframe is added (0 of 276 pairs change on MES).
repainting_indicators.found: No repainting detected. The negative control is clean.

future_data_leakage.how_checked: Strategy ids are a hash of the rule set only - symbol, timeframe, group, conditions, exit identity, filters, directions, confirm_tfs, execution tf - with nothing derived from bars, which is what makes the disjoint- slice lookup valid. Verified that the same ids appear in disjoint slices.
future_data_leakage.found: No leakage into the identity path.

survivorship_bias.how_checked: The contracts are continuous futures series, so there is no delisting survivorship. The relevant survivorship is at the SYMBOL level: this programme studies MES/NQ/MGC/MNQ/MCL because earlier scans found them interesting, and the completed scans also contain MZC, MZS, MZW, SPY and QQQ where TREND's median expectancy is -0.415, +0.050, -0.170, -0.139 and -0.078.
survivorship_bias.found: Real and material. TREND looks like a front-runner on a symbol set chosen after seeing TREND's results. On the five symbols outside that set it is negative on four.

data_mining_bias_deflation.how_checked: T.free_t at the median cell's screened count, against the best observed t.

found.verdict: 0 of 1,818. No strategy is distinguishable from the best of a random search.

insufficient_sample_size.how_checked: Floor-free census at floors 1/5/10/20/40, plus a matched A/B rerun at each floor, plus correlation of expectancy with trade count.
insufficient_sample_size.found: Decisive. Median trade count floor-free is 4-8. TREND's advantage over a matched control is z=+4.93 at n>=20, z=-1.93 at n>=40 and z=-4.78 at n>=60; within TREND, corr(expectancy, trade count) = -0.289. OPENING_RANGE is -0.098R floor-free, +0.003R at floor 20 and +0.099R at floor 40. The floor manufactures most of the apparent edge in this library.

exit_geometry_selection_D6.how_checked: Share of rule sets clearing the floor, by exit geometry, and sign change across the floor.

unrealistic_fills.how_checked: Exit-reason census by timeframe and median hold time.
unrealistic_fills.found: DEFECTS.md D4 is still live and is now WORSE, because the session-guard fix brought daily groups to life. SESSION_CLOSE is the largest exit reason at 60m (49.3% of 93,800 trades), 240m (58.4%) and daily (72.1%), and the median avg-hold is 0.0 minutes at both 240m and daily - trades are opened and force- closed inside one bar. Every 4h and daily number in this worker's studies carries that confound.

understated_costs_and_slippage.how_checked: Gross vs net expectancy per strategy, then re-charging costs at 1.5x, 2x and 3x.

found.verdict: The population's median edge is +0.006R net against a modelled cost drag of +0.007R per trade - roughly half the gross edge is already costs. At 2x the modelled cost the whole floored population's median goes negative (-0.0005R, 49.7% profitable). Nothing here has a cost cushion.

parameter_sensitivity.how_checked: Compared the same rule sets across nine exit geometries and across frame depths 1-4, and compared arms at four trade floors.
parameter_sensitivity.found: High. The same entry logic swings from -0.081R to +0.041R floored depending only on the exit, and every group's verdict flips sign between the floored and floor-free populations for at least one cell. There is no parameter plateau anywhere in these six studies.

nested_window_pseudo_replication_D7.how_checked: Checked id overlap between the 90-day and 274-day floored sets.
nested_window_pseudo_replication_D7.found: Confirmed and quantified. For OPENING_RANGE at 60m, 2 of 2 NQ ids, 1 of 1 MES and 1 of 1 MGC that clear the floor at 90 days are also in the 274-day set, on a strict subset of the same bars. 'Stable across 274/180/90' is one observation reported three times.

group_membership_aliasing_M1.how_checked: Derived every filter that is a base filter of exactly one template and offered nowhere else.

found.verdict: Seven, not three. DEFECTS.md M1 lists after_opening_range, avoid_lunch and opening_drive_window; mtf_not_conflicted (PULLBACK), regime_ranging (MEAN_REVERSION), regime_trending (TREND) and volatility_compressed (BREAKOUT) belong on the same list. Any A/B on those names is a group comparison.

pooled_statistics_inflation_M2.how_checked: Ran every condition-level test both pooled across cells and matched per cell.
pooled_statistics_inflation_M2.found: Reproduced one level up. Pooling per-strategy rows ACROSS cells inflates the same way pooling trades does: within TREND, di_direction is z=-4.32 pooled and z=-1.17 per cell; relative_volume_high in MOMENTUM is z=-2.92 pooled and z=-0.52 per cell; above_vwap is z=-2.16 pooled and z=-0.54 per cell. Not one condition-level effect in these six studies survives per-cell matching.

out_of_sample_and_walk_forward.design: Disjoint slices, not nested windows. The 1h history was cut into three non-overlapping thirds of about 107 days each and the 30m history into two halves. Strategy ids are bar-independent, so a strategy selected in one slice is looked up by id in the next. Selection is by the durability score.

s1->s2.skipped: only 5 ids common to both slices

out_of_sample_and_walk_forward.verdict: Selection does not carry on the equity indices. Spearman correlation between in-sample and out-of-sample expectancy over the common ids: MES +0.027, -0.040, +0.103; NQ +0.010, +0.059, -0.113. MGC is the only contract with any carry: +0.457, +0.247, +0.168. On MES s2->s3 the top-15 selection actually underperformed the out-of-sample population (-0.002R vs +0.014R). Four of the six groups studied could not be walk-forwarded at all - TREND, VWAP's fade half, MOMENTUM's mean-reverting half and OPENING_RANGE produce 0-3 floored strategies per slice and 0-3 ids common to consecutive slices.

new_defects_found_by_this_worker.D11_duplicated_anchored_exits: exits_for() appends ANCHORED_EXITS to every template's catalogue, but five templates build theirs with expand_exit_models(), whose include_anchored default already contains those three. VWAP, OPENING_RANGE, LIQUIDITY, VOLUME_PROFILE and SUPPLY_DEMAND each get a 12-entry catalogue with 9 distinct exits. A quarter of those templates' search budget regenerates exits they already have (the duplicates share a strategy_id and collapse), and it also means a cross-group comparison is not exit-matched by default: TREND has 6 exits, VWAP 9.
new_defects_found_by_this_worker.D12_session_close_flag_is_confounded_wit: exit_at_session_close is False on exactly the three anchored-target exits and True on all six R-multiple ones - 4,213 + 1,777 against 7,205 rule sets, with no overlap. D4 therefore CANNOT be measured on the shipped catalogue: the matched split gives +0.027R vs -0.002R (z=-3.56 over 23 cells, 1,119 vs 1,579 strategies, median hold 818 vs 75 minutes), but that is 'anchored targets beat R-multiple targets' and 'no forced close beats forced close' fused into one arm. To separate them the catalogue needs an R-multiple exit with exit_at_session_close=False.
new_defects_found_by_this_worker.D13_mtf_aligned_equals_mtf_strongly_alig: With two voting timeframes the only agreeing state is 2-of-2, which is exactly mtf_strongly_aligned, and a 1-of-2 split never reaches mtf_aligned's 0.4 threshold. Identical verdicts on 4259/4259 MES 60m bars with [60,240], on 1148/1148 bars at the SHIPPED 240m frame for all five contracts, and on 1859/1859 MES daily bars at the SHIPPED daily frame. The FRAMES fix moved the degeneracy rather than removing it.
new_defects_found_by_this_worker.D14_daily_liquidity_signals_fire_on_zero: The diagnosis the fix commit handed to a worker. After the session guard, after_opening_range passes 1859/1859 daily MES bars as intended, but every liquidity SIGNAL fires on zero of them: overnight_sweep 0, prior_day_sweep 0, session_extreme_sweep 0, prior_day_breakout 0, opening_range_breakout 0, initial_balance_break 0, opening_range_fade 0. LIQUIDITY and OPENING_RANGE both take their only required signal from that pool, so both are still empty at daily. 4h LIQUIDITY, by contrast, now trades (30 MES / 35 MGC / 17 NQ rule sets).
new_defects_found_by_this_worker.D15_opening_range_conditions_are_sub_hou: opening_range_breakout fires on 4 of 4,256 NQ 60m bars, 4 of 4,259 MES, 4 of 4,260 MNQ and 0 of 4,256 MGC; opening_range_fade fires on 0 60m bars on all four. Both fire normally at 15m (17-22% and 4-5%) and 30m. MCL is the exception at 60m (17.9%) because its RTH open falls on a 60m boundary. Any 60m 'opening range' result is measuring prior-day breakouts inside an opening-drive filter.

verified_fixed.D8_deleted_R_multiple_exit: ATRx1.2->1.2R now trades: 681 rule sets with at least one trade and 128 clearing the 20-trade floor across the measured cells. It was 0 everywhere before the fix.
verified_fixed.D8_strategy_id_collision: STRUCTUREx1->1/2/3R and STRUCTUREx1->1/2/3R[ANCHOR_STRUCTURE:0.5/0.75/1] now appear as separate populations - 344 and 1,588 rule sets, 78 and 191 floored. Previously one overwrote the other.
verified_fixed.D2_power_hour_on_MGC: power_hour now fires on MGC: 187 of 4,256 60m bars (4.4%), matching MES's 185 of 4,259. It was 0 of 509 strategies before.
verified_fixed.D1_session_guard: The four time-of-day conditions are now inert at session scale - after_opening_range, power_hour and opening_drive_window each pass 1859/1859 daily MES bars. Daily REVERSAL came alive as a result (18 MES / 39 MGC / 21 MNQ rule sets). Daily LIQUIDITY and OPENING_RANGE did not, for the separate reason in D14.

still_open.D3_session_label: Not fixed. The by-session table in performance_db.json is mislabelled by one bar; do not build a time-of-day rule on it.
still_open.D4_forced_session_close: Not fixed, and not separable from target kind - see D12.
still_open.D9_240m_regime_labels: Not re-tested; 240m results on windows <=180d were avoided for this reason.
still_open.D10_15m_window_span: Confirmed. csv/raw/*_15m.csv spans 58 days, so 274/180/90 all resolve to the same bars; only one 15m window was measured per symbol. NQ_15m.csv does not exist; MNQ was used.

s_freshness.scope: structure age and distance to invalidation, 5 symbols x {60,240} x 3 disjoint slices, two independent simulators
s_freshness.bottom_line: Not live-eligible. The only deflation-clearing result is a prohibition: do not enter when price sits within ~0.5 ATR of its structural invalidation while stopping at that level.

checks.look_ahead_bias: PASS - Swing.confirmed_index filtering; truncation probe reproduced 120/120 rows
checks.unrealistic_fills: PASS - next-bar-open entry, stop-before-target, gaps at the open
checks.understated_costs: FLAGGED - a 0.5-ATR structural stop costs 0.0633 R/trade vs 0.0149 R ungated (4.2x). Gross runs confirm the effect is not purely cost-driven (gross Stouffer -3.852).
checks.insufficient_sample: FLAGGED - the 4h-fresh x near-invalidation conjunction fires on 1.8% of eligible bars (111 trades / 9 cells) and is reported as unusable regardless of sign
checks.data_mining_bias: FLAGGED - ~90 arms screened, free_t = 3.00; no positive arm reaches it
checks.parameter_sensitivity: PASS - both threshold families swept over 7 values; monotone (near) and flat (floor), not knife-edge
checks.out_of_sample: PASS - every headline claim reported on the newest third of bars separately
checks.walk_forward: PARTIAL - 3 disjoint slices per symbol-timeframe with the newest held out; no rolling re-optimisation was run because no parameter was fitted per period
checks.pooling_inflation: AVOIDED - per-cell statistics combined with Stouffer and a sign test
checks.survivorship_bias: N/A for continuous futures series; regime survivorship untested - one ~10.5-month window

negative_findings_to_publish: Entering near structural invalidation raises payoff ratio and lowers win rate in near-exact proportion; expectancy does not move. Third replication of the anchor/execution self-cancellation.
Structure freshness has no measurable effect on any definition (trend-label age or swing-confirmation age), at any bucket, with geometry held constant.
Requiring 60m and 4h structure to agree is already negative (Stouffer -2.684); adding freshness and nearness makes it worse (-3.312, OOS -2.568). Independent reproduction of the mtf_aligned negative.
